jobs.title: R&D Technician
jobs.description_text: ABOUT MARIANA MINERALS Mariana Minerals is a software-first, vertically integrated minerals company on a mission to supply the critical minerals powering modern energy, AI, and defense technologies. We’re reimagining the minerals supply chain by combining deep industry expertise with advanced software, automation, and data-driven decision-making. The Role The R&D Technician executes designed experiments and operates chemical processing equipment to advance Mariana Minerals' hydrometallurgical and purification technologies. This hands-on role focuses on running DOE protocols, operating tank reactors and purification systems, and analyzing data to optimize extraction and separation processes for critical minerals. What You'll Do - Execute Design of Experiments (DOE) protocols for chemical processing, extraction, and purification - Operate tank reactors, filtration systems, separation equipment, and purification units at bench and pilot scale - Prepare chemical solutions and reagents according to experimental specifications - Monitor and control process parameters: temperature, pH, flow rates, residence time, and reagent dosing - Perform systematic sampling and material handling throughout process streams - Collect experimental data including process parameters, weights, volumes, and analytical results - Analyze data using Excel and statistical tools to evaluate performance and identify optimization opportunities - Generate clear data visualizations, charts, and summary reports

jobs.description_text: ABOUT MARIANA MINERALS Mariana Minerals is a software-first, vertically integrated minerals company on a mission to supply the critical minerals powering modern energy, AI, and defense technologies. We’re reimagining the minerals supply chain by combining deep industry expertise with advanced software, automation, and data-driven decision-making. Join our laboratory team as an Analytical Lab Chemist. This senior-level role focuses on high-quality sample preparation and routine analytical testing, with a particular emphasis on ion chromatography (IC). The ideal candidate is a disciplined scientist who prioritizes lab safety, enjoys hands-on analytical work, and has a solid understanding of IC, spectroscopic instrumentation and other chemical analysis equipment. jobs.description_text: ABOUT MESHY Meshy is building the generative AI layer for 3D. Developers, creators, game studios, and enterprise teams use Meshy to turn ideas into production-ready 3D assets in minutes instead of weeks. We’re a Silicon Valley company with a global team, growing fast, and now at the point where the category we’re creating needs a name, a story, and a voice. WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS Today, Meshy is known as a very good AI 3D tool. That’s not enough. The next phase requires Meshy to be understood as a company with a defined category position, a long-term vision, and real cultural weight in AI and creative software. You’ll be the person who answers these questions and then makes the whole company answer them the same way: - What does Meshy stand for in AI, 3D, and creative tools? - Why should developers, creators, game companies, and enterprise buyers care about Meshy now? - What is the single story that connects our product, our founders, our customers, the press, and our industry partners? This is a founding brand role. You will write, not just direct. jobs.description_text: ABOUT ODYS At Odys, we’re mobilizing power, with Hybrid Power Systems developed for aerospace and in-demand everywhere. We designed, tested, and validated our first 1 MW high-speed generator in 12 months. And then we pushed further, developing systems with greater power density in less time. Today, our Hybrid Power Systems offer outputs ranging from 20 kW to 4 MW, with applications in the air or on the ground. One of those applications is Laila, an unmanned drone designed for critical logistics and defense missions. With its 100 kW-class onboard Hybrid Power System, Laila can support medical cold-chain transport or serve as an aerial platform for counter-UAS measures. The market interest has been overwhelming: Over 30 inbound requests from leading US and global manufacturers, and 14+ DoD contracts. Our team comes from deep tech and aerospace, with backgrounds spanning drone and aircraft development, high-volume production, and electrified mobility. We designed, tested, and validated our first 1 MW high-speed generator in 12 months. And then we pushed further, developing systems with greater power density in less time. Today, our Hybrid Power Systems offer outputs ranging from 20 kW to 4 MW, with applications in the air or on the ground. One of those applications is Laila, an unmanned drone designed for critical logistics and defense missions. With its 100 kW-class onboard Hybrid Power System, Laila can support medical cold-chain transport or serve as an aerial platform for counter-UAS measures. The market interest has been overwhelming: Over 30 inbound requests from leading US and global manufacturers, and 14+ DoD contracts. Our team comes from deep tech and aerospace, with backgrounds spanning drone and aircraft development, high-volume production, and electrified mobility. We operate with urgency and ownership at every level. We validated high-speed generator technology faster than our peers, not because we skipped steps, but because we've been doing this long enough to know which ones matter most. Creating the future of power, in the air and on the ground, is a challenge we’ve been training our entire lives for. If that sounds like you, t

jobs.title: Head of Content
jobs.description_text: HEAD OF CONTENT Outmarket AI · Remote (US) · Full-time · Reports to the SVP of Marketing ABOUT OUTMARKET Insurance still runs on manual work. Most policies are sold through agents and brokers, and the people who know the work best are buried in the documents: checking policies line by line, comparing quotes, building proposals, on nights and weekends. We think that's backwards. The best people in insurance should spend their time advising clients. Outmarket, the AI platform built for insurance, makes that possible. Account teams drop in their documents and get back finished work to review, with every finding linked to the page it came from. Outmarket connects to the systems they already use. The judgment stays with the person; the groundwork doesn't. It's working. More than 10,000 people at over 300 agencies use Outmarket, including 30 of the top 100 U.S. insurance brokers. Most of those agencies found us through other customers. We raised a $34.5M Series B led by SignalFire four months after announcing our Series A because customers were pulling us forward faster than we planned. WHY THIS ROLE - Customers who want to talk. About 300 agencies use Outmarket, and most will go on record about it. Few content leaders start with that many stories ready to tell. - First in the seat. You'll be our first content hire, joining alongside a new Head of Product Marketing and Head of Growth. You'll decide what Outmarket sounds and looks like. - Real creative room, and a budget to use it.

Perplexity serves Ask, Computer and API traffic on GPU capacity across multiple cloud and neocloud providers, and demand shifts with every new customer, product launch and model release. Working across engineering, research, Finance and providers, you’ll forecast how much compute we need and when, bring new capacity into production, and own how the fleet performs today, driving fixes when reliability, utilization or cost fall short. The ideal candidate knows GPU fleets, handles technical and commercial details, and is energized by building a function with little precedent. OUR MISSION Perplexity’s mission is to power curiosity. Curious people are the people who drive change in the world. Driving change is a continuous cycle of learning, building, and integrating. Learn: curious people constantly learn new things by asking more. They question the status quo in their own expertise and they constantly learn outside of it. Research is essential to them and never ending. Build: curious people make and create things, to show the world their new answers to problems no one else ever questioned. They take action on what they’ve learned. Makers need tools to create their products, their companies, their reality. jobs.description_text: We’re looking for a Deal Desk Lead to help our GTM teams structure and close deals that support durable revenue growth. You’ll partner with the field, the Head of Revenue Operations, and Finance and Legal leadership to balance customer needs with company priorities. You’ll own Deal Desk end to end and build the team as we grow. This is a hands-on role for someone who moves with urgency and finds workable solutions, not simply obstacles or approval paths. WHAT YOU’LL DO - Partner with the field: Engage early on complex opportunities, understand customer needs, and remove obstacles to close. Bring Sales, Finance, and Legal together to resolve issues quickly. - Structure deals and balance trade-offs: Shape pricing, discounts, commitments, and payment terms. Weigh customer value, revenue, profitability, and risk, offering practical alternatives rather than a simple yes or no. - Own review and approvals: Run a responsive process for nonstandard deals and exceptions. Apply policies consistently and escalate decisions beyond your authority with clear options and a recommendation. - Ensure accurate execution: Ensure quotes, order forms, approvals, and CRM records reflect agreed terms. jobs.title: Go-To-Market Compensation Lead
jobs.description_text: We’re looking for a Go-To-Market Compensation Lead to build and scale the incentive compensation programs that support our revenue growth. You’ll lead compensation design in partnership with the Head of Revenue Operations and GTM and Finance leadership, translating business priorities into plans that are clear, motivating, and financially sound. You’ll own commission operations end to end, including our incentive compensation management (ICM) system. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can move from strategic recommendations to detailed execution, operate independently through ambiguity, and take extreme ownership of both the numbers and the employee experience. What you’ll do - Lead compensation design: Partner with the Head of Revenue Operations and GTM and Finance leadership to develop and evolve incentive plans across GTM roles. Recommend performance measures, payout structures, accelerators, and crediting rules that align incentives with company goals. - Model business impact: Build scenarios to assess compensation cost, earnings opportunities, and incentive alignment. Evaluate plan performance and recommend changes as our products, pricing, and go-to-market motion evolve. - Own commission operations: Run the full commission cycle, from source-data validation and crediting through calculations, reconciliation, approvals, and payroll handoff. jobs.description_text: Perplexity is revolutionizing how companies get work done, from the Fortune 500 to one-person ecommerce shops. You'll set the strategy for and build our customer storytelling and advocacy program, working closely with Sales, Customer Success, Product Marketing, Comms, Brand, and Legal. jobs.description_text: Enterprises are rolling Perplexity out to thousands of employees and connecting it to their most sensitive internal data. Their security teams want to know how to do that safely, and they want to hear it from someone who has done real security work. ABOUT THE ROLE We're looking for a Cybersecurity Solutions Architect to be that person. You'll be the security expert our enterprise customers work with as they deploy Perplexity: running architecture and hardening sessions with their security leads, reviewing how they're configuring identity, data access, and admin controls, and helping them get to a setup they're confident in. You'll sit on the Security team and work closely with our enterprise sales, customer success, and product teams, and you'll bring what you learn from customers back into how we build and secure the product. jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff (Index, Search Crawler)
jobs.description_text: AI answers are only as trustworthy as the information behind them. Perplexity grounds its answers in fresh, real-world sources, and the index is what makes that possible. We're looking for an engineer to work on the indexing and data processing layer of Perplexity's Search Crawler. You'll build systems that ingest, process, and organize large volumes of crawled content into efficient, queryable structures, working primarily on offline and nearline pipelines that keep data fresh, complete, and accessible to downstream retrieval. Throughput, scalability, and correctness are critical across datasets that change continuously. jobs.title: Partnerships Manager
jobs.description_text: WHO WE ARE Foundation models transformed text and images. Structured data - the largest and most consequential data format in the world - stayed untouched, until now. What LLMs did for language, we're doing for tables. We pioneered tabular foundation models: TabPFN v2 was a Nature https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-024-08328-6 cover story, has passed 3.5M+ downloads and 7,500+ GitHub stars, and runs in production from detecting lung disease with Oxford Cancer Analytics https://www.oxcan.org/news/prior-labs-and-oxford-cancer-analytics-partner-to-advance-liquid-biopsy-and-clinical-decision-making-in-lung-disease to preventing train failures with Hitachi https://siliconangle.com/2025/12/01/prior-labs-debuts-tabular-ai-foundation-model-scales-10-million-rows/. The hardest problems - millions of rows, real-time inference, entirely new modalities - are still open, and no one else is working on them at this level. We're a small, highly selective team of 40+ https://priorlabs.ai/about with backgrounds from Google, DeepMind, Meta, Apple, Amazon, Jane Street, and CERN, led by Frank Hutter https://www.linkedin.com/in/frank-hutter-9190b24b/, Noah Hollmann https://www.linkedin.com/in/noah-hollmann-668b9010b/, and Sauraj Gambhir https://www.linkedin.com/in/sauraj-g/, and advised by Bernhard Schölkopf and Turing Award winner Yann LeCun. In July 2026, less than 18 months after our €9M pre-seed, we joined SAP https://priorlabs.ai/blog-posts/priorlabs-sap as an independent frontier AI lab

This is a hands-on role for a thoughtful lawyer who enjoys variety, moves quickly, and wants to help build a strong employment legal function as the business scales. You will collaborate with experienced employment counsel on US and international employment issues, the employment aspects of mergers and acquisitions, and emerging questions about AI in the workplace. A central part of your work will be turning lessons from individual matters into practical policies, guidance, and approaches that work at scale. You will also own stakeholder relationships and manage counseling matters, exercising sound judgment and taking responsibility for outcomes.
